question: What the single unit panel's edit_theatre button does: when it is shown and pressable, what it opens, how it ends, what command it posts and what that command does.

addresses.name: CSingleUnitButtons::OnEditTheatreButton
addresses.comment: **`edit_theatre`'s click** (the glue at +0x3B8, made at VA 0x75D23A with this handler and registered on the button at VA 0x75D6E6; the constructor then sets the button's frame to 1, VA 0x75D73A). Nothing under the custom-game lock (0x4208B0), as every handler of the strip. Otherwise **a toggle on the button's own frame**: where the button's slot 19 answers 1 (the frame; slot 18 is SetFrame) - the in-game screen's (game state +0xBE8) slot 106, CInGameIdler::ToggleTheatreEditing, with 1, then SetFrame(2); otherwise slot 106 with 0, then SetFrame(1). **No command and no test of the unit here**: the button is shown only for oob_level 0 (CSingleUnitButtons::Update) and nothing in the image greys it. `GFX_edit_theatre` has noOfFrames = 2, so frame 2 is the button drawn down while the editor is on. `ret 4`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-attachbuttons.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: disasm VA 0x75DC00-0x75DDD3 (one ret 4, ten int3 after); the glue +0x3B8 is built with `mov ecx, 0x75dc00` at VA 0x75D240 and registered on the element found by the string 'edit_theatre' at VA 0x75D6A5-0x75D6E6; findRefs on the string gives six sites (constructor twice, this handler, Update's hide and show, BuildTooltip) and no other. vtable.py --holding: in no table. That slot 19 is the frame getter is inferred from slot 18 being SetFrame (MapMode_ShowButton) and the toggle shape; wrong if slot 19 answered something else, in which case the button would not alternate.

addresses.comment: **The command the theatre editor posts.** The storage and the province CList on the stack, the theatre's id pair by address in ECX; `ret 8`, the command in EAX. CCommand's base as every command's (class id 0x18D at +4, the empty name at +8, type 0x73C at +0x2C and +0x30, 0xFFFF at +0x34, +0x24/+0x28/+0x36/+0x38 zero), vftable 0x15C955C; +0x3C/+0x40 = the pair (type, id); +0x44..+0x50 an empty CList, then **each province id of the given list appended in its order** (CList_PushBack). Two callers, both the in-game screen: CInGameIdler_HandleInput at a drag's release in map mode 17 (VA 0x652D00) and CInGameIdler::SetTheatreEditing on leaving the editor (VA 0x66670A); both pass the theatre's own +8/+0xC and the screen's edit list (+0x6C). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-attachbuttons.md, section 9.

addresses.evidence: disasm VA 0x5E9FC0-0x5EA008; `lea ecx,[esi+0x44]; call 0x8A30D0` (CList::FreeNodes, rva 0x4A30D0), `test byte [ebp+8],1` before operator delete. vtable.py --holding: CUpdateTheatreCommand slot 0 only.

addresses.name: CUpdateTheatreCommand::Execute
addresses.comment: **Slot 6: the provinces go to the theatre.** Bare `ret`. The theatre from its id pair (+0x3C/+0x40) through FindPersistentById (registry [0x1A857F0] where the type is above 0x1268, else [0x1A857F4]); **nothing at all where it no longer exists**. Then for each province id of +0x44, in order: the province (game state +0xB8C); the theatre its stamp names (CMapProvince +0x380/+0x384, looked up the same way) - where one resolves, CTheatre_DropProvince(it, province), which takes it off that theatre's fronts, provinces, key provinces and added provinces - and then CTheatre::AddProvince(this theatre, province): appended to +0x30 and +0x60 and stamped. A province already in this theatre is dropped and appended again, at the end. Last, **CAIStrategy::RefreshTheatreProvinces(strategy of the theatre's country (country database by CTheatre +0x80, +0x48C), false)** - with the flag false nothing is placed and nothing unheld dropped; every theatre's stamps, areas, ports and fronts are made again and MaintainTheatres(strategy, true) runs. **It tests nothing else**: not who posted it, not who owns or controls the provinces, not whether the theatre is the poster's; IsValid asks only for a non-empty list. It reads nothing local, so it does the same on every peer. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-attachbuttons.md, section 9.
addresses.evidence: disasm VA 0x5EA0E0-0x5EA26D (bare ret, two int3 then slot 7); loop 0x5EA14E-0x5EA229: provinces[[node]] at 0x5EA1DB, stamp +0x380/+0x384 at 0x5EA1DE, call 0x4AFA70 (CTheatre_DropProvince, push province; push old) where the lookup is non-null, then `mov eax,theatre; push province; call 0x4AF950` (AddProvince, receiver EAX). Tail 0x5EA22F-0x5EA257: theatre +0x80 indexes [0x1A855A4]+0x16C, +0x48C, `push 0` then the strategy, call 0x8ABC90. RefreshTheatreProvinces' flag test at VA 0x8ABCAB jumps to 0x8ABE1C, past both the placing and the dropping loops. Wrong if a second caller of 0x4AFA70/0x4AF950 existed in this body that the read skipped.

addresses.name: MapMode_TheatreEditor_Colour
addresses.comment: **Map mode 17's colours** (the theatre editor). The argument is the graphics owner's +0x1DC4 (its province colour entries at +0x2C..+0x30, CMap at +0x40). Every province from index 1: grey g = 0.5 x (1.0 where the player's knowledge of it - CMapProvince +0x370 by the player's id, CMap +0x2A8C - is 2 or more, else 0.5), and 0 where it is not simulated (template +0x13D); alpha 1. addresses.name: CInGameIdler::SetTheatreEditing
addresses.comment: **Slot 110: map mode 17, the theatre editor, on and off.** Given a headquarters: +0x7C = it, PushMapMode, the air (mode 18) and naval (mode 19) icons put down as every setter does, +0xD34 and CMap +0x2A90 = 17, settings +0xE7 = 0, layer mask +0xF0 = 0xFFBE, map style +0xF4 = 2, the graphics owner's word +0x60F8 = 0, HideProvinceObjects98, MapMode_TheatreEditor_Colour (VA 0x865290), Map_RefreshColourTextures(0), +0x60DC = 1. **No MapMode_ShowButton**, and it touches neither the edit list nor +0x80. Given null: PopMapMode; then, where +0x7C was set, the edit list (**+0x6C**, its count at +0x74) is not empty and CUnit_FindTheatre(+0x7C) finds a theatre, a CUpdateTheatreCommand(that theatre's id pair, the list) (`new 0x54`, 0x5EA010) is posted to the session (game state +0xBE8, slot 18, its +0x38's slot 6); then +0x7C = 0, CList_FreeAndClear(+0x6C) and +0x80 = 0. The list is normally empty by then, since each drag's release posts and frees it (CInGameIdler_HandleInput); what can be left is a drag released while GetSelectedUnit answered nothing. Callers: CInGameIdler::ToggleTheatreEditing (slot 106, the `edit_theatre` button), CInGameIdler_HandleInput (a typed Ctrl+R) and CInGameIdler_RefreshMap (twice, with null). `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-minimap.md, section 5, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-attachbuttons.md, section 9.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_DrawSelectionBox
addresses.comment: **The drag box on the map**, drawn every frame while CInGameIdler_IsDragging holds (one caller, 0x657197, in the frame's drawing). Five points at height 0 - the press's ground point (+0x12F4, +0x12FC) and the one now under the pointer, (x1,z1) (x2,z1) (x2,z2) (x1,z2) (x1,z1) - **a closed outline on the ground, square to the map's axes**, not to the screen; drawn with the ID3DXLine at +0x1CCC - SetWidth(2.0), so **two pixels wide**, Begin, DrawTransform(the 5 points, the map's translation (-+0x1C74, -+0x1C78) times the camera's view and projection, the colour), End - with depth test and depth writes off (render states 7 and 14 set 0, back to 1 after); colour **white**, CColor(1,1,1,1) brightened by 1.1 and clamped (0x643750), packed. In map mode 17 the colour is the selected theatre's: the theatre (CUnit_FindTheatre of GetSelectedUnit) is counted along the player's CCountry +0x570 list and takes **the colour of the region with that index** (CMap +0x2A40, RegionOrContinent_GetColour, then the same 1.1 brightening); **(0.8,0,0) only where the index is not below the number of regions** - a theatre not in the list, or none, counts as the list's length, so it too gets a region's colour while regions outnumber theatres. Then, only where a theatre is selected and **the pointer's ground point has moved more than 2 (truncated, in x or in z) since the last sample** (+0x12E8/+0x12F0, rewritten then), each province of the player's ControlledProvinces (CCountry +0xD00) that is not already stamped with that theatre and whose area (+0x2B4) answers its slot 0 (a real area): where its label point (template +0x5C, +0x60) lies inside the box grown by 2 on every side, it is appended to the edit list +0x6C (CList_Contains first) and its colour entry (graphics owner +0x1DF0) set to the box colour; where it lies outside and is in the list, it is taken out (CList_RemoveNode) and given back the colour of the theatre its stamp names, counted the same way, or (0.5,0.5,0.5) past the regions. So the box gathers live, in the order provinces enter it; Map_RefreshColourTextures(0) where any colour changed. That list is what the release posts in a CUpdateTheatreCommand. `ret 4`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-selection.md, section A, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-attachbuttons.md, section 9.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_HandleInput
addresses.comment: **The in-game screen's handler for the mouse and keys over the map**, called once a frame from CInGameIdler::Update (0x656471), `ret 4`. First, anything selected whose kind (selectable slot 1) is 9 - the CSelectable default, which no class with RTTI answers - clears the selection (slot 46). Then +0x1DD4 = MapGraphics_PickUnderPointer (the thing under the pointer) and +0x1DD0 = the province under it, and the frame's input events (+0x1CB0; event +0 key code, +4 Windows message 0x100 key down or 0x102 character, +8 0 mouse or 1 key, +0x10 3 press or 4 release, +0x14 button 1 left 2 right, +0x18 handled byte, +0x20 next) are walked in order. **Left press** (not handled): +0x1300 = 1, +0x12F4 = the ground point under the pointer (CMap 0x492850), the down byte +0x12E0 = 1. **Left release with the down byte set** (no handled test): the right-click menu (+0x1D90) hidden, +0x12E0 = 0, and CInGameIdler_IsDragging decides. *A click* (not a drag): a deployment being placed is posted first where it may be (FINDINGS-buildingqueue.md B.4, unchanged); otherwise +0x1314 = the thing under the pointer, and with Shift (keyboard slot 10) and something under it: already selected - Selection_Remove (selection_changed where it was an air unit); not selected and Selection_CanAdd - added without clearing; otherwise with anything selected nothing at all. Without Shift (or with nothing under the pointer): the side menus and the orders view closed, Selection_Clear, the unit rows (+0xD20) freed, selection_changed, 0x66B7B0, an open country view toggled shut, then the thing selected where Selection_CanAdd allows; with Ctrl (keyboard slot 12) and an army (kind 0) CUnit::SelectSubordinates; without Ctrl, the deploy menu reopened where exactly one thing is selected and the clear had closed it. +0x12E4 = -1 after any add. *A drag*: in map mode 17, with a unit selected (GetSelectedUnit) and the edit list +0x6C not empty, a CUpdateTheatreCommand(CUnit_FindTheatre(that unit)'s id pair, the list) is posted where the theatre exists, and the list freed either way once a theatre was looked for - no selection change, no unit walks; otherwise **Alt (keyboard slot 11) held does nothing at all**; else the selection is cleared as for a click (no selection_changed, no deploy-menu reopen) unless Shift is held and unit rows exist (+0xD28), and then three walks of the player's country's units (CCountry +0xBAC, every level): land units in a land province, then fleets, then air units, each taken where its map position (slot 30) lies within the box between the two ground points grown by 2 on every side and Selection_CanAdd allows - so the first unit taken fixes the kind and land wins; +0x12E4 = -1 for each. +0x1300 = 0, and 0x663400 outside mode 17. **Right release**: with nothing selected, no rows and the left button up, the province right-click menu (0x6754B0). Then, with +0x1CE0 clear and a province under the pointer: an orders view up and shown gets its slot 4 (province, Shift); otherwise, unless a visible interface element is under the mouse (gui +0x98, +0x43), **every selected thing in selection order gets its slot 6 (province, Shift)** - CUnit::OrderToProvince for units. **Keys**: Pause (key down) or Space (character) outside multiplayer slot 27 (the pause, *inferred*, not read); the console on 0xA7 or '`'; **'0' to '9' CInGameIdler_SelectionGroupKey**; '+' and '-' slots 25 and 26 (the speed, *inferred*); Home (KeyEvent_IsHomeDown) slot 47 with the player's capital; the character 0x12 - **Ctrl+R typed**: the test is in the character-message (0x102) branch, and the window procedure queues WM_SYSKEYDOWN as 0x104 and has no WM_SYSCHAR case, so Alt cannot reach it - outside mode 17, with a level-0 unit selected alone (CInGameIdler::GetSelectedUnit, oob_level +0x1F4 = 0) whose owner (+0x128) is the player (slot 23): CInGameIdler::SetTheatreEditing(it) (slot 110) and **+0x80 = 1**, which makes CInGameIdler_RefreshMap end the editor the next frame unless Keyboard_IsAltDown answers - *inferred* never, so this shortcut is dead in practice (FINDINGS-attachbuttons.md section 9); 'h' render_hierarchy (FINDINGS-hierarchy.md); Escape (key down) clears the selection (slot 46) or else 0x66BD10(0). There is no double click: nothing here reads a clock. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-selection.md, section A.

addresses.name: CInGameIdler_RefreshMap
addresses.comment: **The in-game screen's map refresh, every frame**: called once, from CInGameIdler::Update (at VA 0x655EF4), on a join that no branch of Update jumps over (Update has one `ret`, at VA 0x656B80), before CInGameIdler_HandleInput (called at VA 0x656471) and after CInGameIdler_UpdatePanels (called at VA 0x655E2E). `ret 4`. **Map mode 17 first**: in mode 17, where +0x80 is set (the editor entered by Ctrl+R) and Keyboard_IsAltDown (keyboard slot 11) answers false, SetTheatreEditing(null); otherwise, where GetSelectedUnit answers nothing or a unit whose oob_level (+0x1F4) is not 0, SetTheatreEditing(null) - **so the editor ends the frame after the theatre headquarters stops being the one thing selected**. Outside mode 17, every frame: +0x7C = 0, the edit list +0x6C freed, +0x80 = 0. Then, where the current mode's (+0xD34) entry of the table +0x30 is 1, that mode's **setter** (the mode being already its own, it plays no sound) - 1 MapMode_Political_Colour, 2 MapMode_Diplomatic_Colour, 6 MapMode_Intel_Colour, 5 MapMode_Infrastructure_Colour, 8 MapMode_Theatre_Colour, 17 slot 15 and MapMode_TheatreEditor_Refresh (rva 0x241DC0) then Map_RefreshColourTextures(0), 4 MapMode_Supply_Colour, 7 MapMode_VictoryPoints_Recolour, 9 MapMode_Strength_Colour - and the table's 20 entries zeroed. Then, **where the refresh flags (+0x84) are not 0**: **0x100**, the same setters for modes 1, 2, 6, 5, 8, 4, 7 and 9; **2**, in mode 6 the intel setter; **& 0xF**, the intel setter in mode 6 (once a frame in all), rva 0x266020 (the terrain mode's setter) in mode 0 unless the flags are exactly 2, MapMode_Weather_Set in mode 11, MapGraphics_RefreshByFlags(the CProvinceManager, the flags, &+0x88) and FowTexture_Update; **0x200**, Map_RefreshColourTextures(textures, entries, 0) - both province colour lookups refilled from each province's selected byte as it stands, which is how a selection reaches the map. Then +0x84 = 0, the changed-province list +0x88 emptied (rva 0x4E7DD0), and the graphics owner's +0x60DC = 1. **0x200 is set only by CProvince::OnSelected and CProvince::OnDeselected** (VA 0x49E47D, 0x49E592); Province_SetController ORs **1** (VA 0x4A3585, bit 0) and 0x100 (0x4A35CE); **0x100 also** CMapProvince::SetOwner (0x4A2344), the Apply of the war declaration (0xA146E7), alliance (0xA1A416), military access (0xA247A1), offered military access (0xA26CE7), NAP (0xA2C8CC) and faction (0xA32FA8) actions, CAlliance::Activate (0xA46BC9) and Deactivate (0xA46D79) and SetMilitaryAccess (0xA4A531); ApplyCustomGameSettings, CCountry_Capitulate and the front end's enter 0xF, the in-game enter 0xB; **2** CLocalIntelBoost::Execute (0x9BE658) and CInGameIdler slot 56 (rva 0x272BE0, at VA 0x6731EC: a pass over every province that recomputes its byte +0x36D from where the player's and its allies' units stand and Province_IsHiddenByFog, and sets 2 for each province whose byte changed). Every setter named here also calls Map_RefreshColourTextures, so each of them re-applies the selection lift too. The name is ours. addresses.name: CSingleUnitButtons::Update
addresses.comment: The strip of buttons, every frame; **read whole**. Opens by setting a lock where a custom game's local player is marked (0x4208B0). Shows one of `create_corps`, `create_army`, `create_armygroup`, `create_theatre`, `edit_theatre` by oob_level (4, 3, 2, 1, 0) - **`edit_theatre` is never greyed, here or anywhere** (the string's six references are the constructor's binding, its handler CSingleUnitButtons::OnEditTheatreButton, this hide and show and BuildTooltip), so the editor is open to any level-0 unit the player may select, under an AI agent too - and disables the four create buttons together where the unit has a parent no more than one level up, a custom game forbids it (0x420EB0) or manpower is short; `attach_button` for a unit with none above and `detach_button` for one with; the three checkboxes from +0xA4, +0xA6 and +0xA5. **Load and unload**: a land unit aboard a fleet (AsArmy +0x300) shows `unload_button`, hides `load_button`, and enables the unload where the province it is in is land (its template's is_land, +0xD4 -> +0x22) - **a fleet in port** - else disables it; a land unit aboard nothing shows `load_button` enabled where CSingleUnitButtons_FindFleetToBoard finds a fleet; anything else (not a land unit, or a land unit aboard an air unit) hides both. The plane pair the same way: aboard an air unit (+0x304) `unload_plane_button` shown and enabled where CUnit_IsAtOwnBase(that air unit); aboard nothing `load_plane_button` enabled where CSingleUnitButtons_FindPlanesToBoard finds one; otherwise both hidden. Then, under the lock, the checkboxes are locked and `disbandbutton` and `newunitbutton` disabled; otherwise `disbandbutton` is disabled, at the first that holds: a land unit aboard a fleet (+0x300) or a plane (+0x304); **a level-0 unit (oob_level +0x1F4 is 0) whose theatre (CUnit_FindTheatre) still holds provinces (its added_provinces_count, CTheatre +0x68, is above nought)**; a unit with an AI agent (+0x198); a unit on loan (expeditionary_owner_id +0x290 set); in a battle (+0x11C > 0) - and otherwise enabled. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-smallbatch.md. **`newunitbutton`** is disabled, at the first that holds: a land unit of regiments_count 1 or less - **2 or less where its leader is real** (slot 8); in a battle (+0x11C); an AI agent (+0x198) on it or on any unit above it (+0x1E0 walked); on loan (+0x290); a fleet or an air unit carrying anything (+0x2EC); a land unit aboard a fleet (+0x300) or a plane (+0x304); an attack delay (+0xD4 > 0); and otherwise **enabled only where the screen's slot 51 answers 1 and regiments_count is above 1**. **The tail** (observer +0x394/+0x398 - the strip's +0x3B0/+0x3B4, the new unit waiting from CSingleUnitButtons::OnNewUnitButton): once FindPersistentByIdPair finds it, the id is cleared, the new unit is added to the selection (screen slot 38), the reorganise window is opened (screen slot 49, CInGameIdler::OnReorganiseButton - the panel's unit first, the new one second), and where the panel's unit has a parent (+0x1E0) and CUnit_MayTakeSubordinate(parent, **the panel's unit**, 0) - not the new one - a CAttachUnitCommand(new unit, parent) is posted. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-unitpanel.md, section 9, reversing/findings/FINDINGS-transport.md, section C.1, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-newunit.md.

structs.name: CUpdateTheatreCommand
structs.comment: The theatre editor's command: a theatre by id pair and the provinces to give it. Type 0x73C. Made only by the in-game screen (a drag's release in map mode 17, and leaving the editor); Execute moves each province from whatever theatre its stamp names into this one, then refreshes the owner's theatres. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-attachbuttons.md, section 9.
structs.evidence: both constructors `new 0x54` (VA 0x652CC5, 0x6666DD, and Clone's push 0x54); RTTI: CCommand at offset 0; table 0x15C955C (VA) = rva 0x11C955C, 15 slots.

struct_fields.name: theatre_id_type
struct_fields.comment: Type half of the theatre's object id pair (CTheatre +8). Saved as the `theatre` key with +0x40.
struct_fields.evidence: constructor copies [ecx] here; Execute passes &+0x3C to FindPersistentById; SaveContents writes &+0x3C after token 0x465.

struct_fields.name: theatre_id
struct_fields.comment: Serial half of the theatre's id pair (CTheatre +0xC).
struct_fields.evidence: constructor copies [ecx+4] here; Execute reads it with +0x3C.

struct_fields.name: provinces_first
struct_fields.comment: Head of a CList of province ids (node +0 the id, +8 next), in the order the drag gathered them. Saved as `area`.
struct_fields.evidence: constructor pushes each id with CList_PushBack(+0x44); Execute walks [+0x44] by node+8 indexing game state +0xB8C; SaveContents writes it with SaveWriteIntList under 0x648.

struct_fields.name: provinces_last
struct_fields.evidence: zeroed with the list by every constructor; CList layout (first, last, count).

struct_fields.name: provinces_count
struct_fields.comment: How many provinces; IsValid answers whether it is not nought.

struct_fields.name: theatre_edit_provinces_first
struct_fields.comment: Head of the theatre editor's edit list: a CList of province ids gathered by the drag box in map mode 17 (CInGameIdler_DrawSelectionBox), posted as a CUpdateTheatreCommand at the release (CInGameIdler_HandleInput) or on leaving (CInGameIdler::SetTheatreEditing), freed by both and every frame outside mode 17 (CInGameIdler_RefreshMap). Node +0 the id, +4 previous, +8 next.
struct_fields.evidence: DrawSelectionBox appends 0x10-byte nodes {id, old tail, 0, 0} at VA 0x64DF8A-0x64DFC7 and tests membership with CList_Contains(+0x6C); the two posts pass &+0x6C to 0x5EA010; CList_FreeAndClear(+0x6C) at 0x652DC5, 0x6667C2, 0x651710.

struct_fields.name: theatre_edit_provinces_last
struct_fields.evidence: DrawSelectionBox stores the new node at +0x70 and links it from the old tail's +8 (VA 0x64DFB8, 0x64DFC2).

struct_fields.name: theatre_edit_provinces_count
struct_fields.comment: Count of the edit list. Both posts are skipped where it is not above nought.
struct_fields.evidence: incremented at VA 0x64DFBB; `cmp [ebx+0x74],0; jle` at 0x652CAA and 0x6666C5.

struct_fields.name: theatre_edit_hq
struct_fields.comment: The headquarters the theatre editor was opened for (CInGameIdler::SetTheatreEditing). Read only on leaving, for the theatre of a list left over; the drag posts for GetSelectedUnit's theatre instead. Zeroed on leaving and every frame outside mode 17.
struct_fields.evidence: SetTheatreEditing stores its argument at VA 0x6667D5 and reads it at 0x6666BA before CUnit_FindTheatre; zeroed at 0x6667B8 and 0x651709.

struct_fields.name: theatre_edit_by_key
struct_fields.comment: Set where the theatre editor was entered by the typed Ctrl+R (CInGameIdler_HandleInput). While it is set, CInGameIdler_RefreshMap ends the editor on any frame Keyboard_IsAltDown answers false - so the key path was meant as hold-to-edit; with that test inferred always false, it lasts one frame. Cleared on leaving and every frame outside mode 17.

struct_fields.name: theatre_drag_last_sample
struct_fields.comment: The ground point at which the mode-17 drag last re-gathered the box (x +0x12E8, z +0x12F0). The box is re-gathered only once the pointer's point differs from it by more than 2 in x or z, truncated to whole units. Nothing seen resets it at a press. Only the mode-17 gathering's use was read.
